Title: Public Preview: Azure Data Explorer Add-On for Splunk

Body.Content:
We're excited to announce the public preview of Azure Data Explorer Add-On for Splunk.

Azure Data Explorer is a fast and scalable data analytics platform designed for real-time analysis of large volumes of data. Splunk Enterprise is a software platform that allows you to ingest data from many sources simultaneously.

Azure Data Explorer Add-on for Splunk allows users to effortlessly ingest data from Splunk to Azure Data Explorer.

Learn more from our documentation or from our blog.

Try it out today and let us know what you think!
